system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

| #### Crimson Pact / Fortitude Amp / You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits; / Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions. / Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute. / Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points. |

By leaving traces of your chakra within the blood of your allies, you can form a bond of blood with them known as a Crimson Pact. This Crimson Pact is represented as a special marking on the bonded creature of either of your designs, in a place where blood flows strongest (chest, wrist, neck, back, etc.). You can perform this ritual over the course of a Long Rest with a willing creature you can reach. You can only have one creature actively Bonded at a time.

While bonded both you and the allied creature gain the Crimson Pact status. If either creature willingly dismisses the bond, dies, or is the target of an effect that can dispel a Jutsu of B-Rank or lower, this effect ends on them.
